contexts.text: They who pertain to the lymphatics are afterwards carried into places which they said relate to the mesentery. I have been told that there are as it were labyrinths there; and that they are afterwards taken away thence to various places in the Grand Man, in order to serve for use, as is the chyle in the body.

Those who receive are carried to their places through infinite windings... almost as is the chyle through the mesentery and the lacteal vessels there into the receptacle; and from this through the thoracic duct into the blood.
